architecture.mechanism: Numerical modeling of temperature fields to predict wave-front arrival variations caused by thermal gradients.
architecture.intervention: Integrate a real-time finite element thermal model into the vehicle's battery management system to predict thermal runaway propagation paths and trigger targeted coolant injection before fire ignition.
architecture.expected_effect: Early suppression of thermal events by addressing temperature inhomogeneities prior to the onset of combustion, preventing post-collision fires.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject a 2021 Toyota RAV4 battery pack to controlled crash-induced thermal stress while running the intervention algorithm; failure occurs if the system does not activate coolant delivery before temperatures exceed the electrolyte flash point in the predicted hot-spot zone.
